title: Clearwater Forest the Next Generation Intel® Xeon® Processor with Efficiency Cores
problem: Multi-core Xeon processors need improved power efficiency and performance balance across diverse workloads.
motivation: Data center workloads require efficiency cores to balance performance and energy consumption in large-scale deployments.
method: Clearwater Forest adds lower-power 'efficiency cores' alongside high-performance cores in Xeon processors. The processor can direct lightweight workloads to these efficiency cores, while sending demanding computations to the more powerful cores. This flexible assignment reduces overall power consumption because simpler tasks no longer require activating the processor's most energy-hungry components.
key_novelty: Xeon processors now include efficiency cores alongside performance cores, allowing the processor to use low-power cores for routine tasks instead of always relying on energy-intensive high-performance cores.
contributions: Heterogeneous core architecture combining P-cores and E-cores in Xeon
Improved power efficiency for data center workloads
